cases.description: A non-recursive inductive whose single field mentions no inductive: accepted, so the recursor the builder spells out is exactly the one the kernel derives.
cases.name: positive-control

cases.description: `Bad | mk : ((Bad → Prop) → Prop) → Bad`: `Bad` occurs to the left of an arrow inside a field. The field is not a recursive argument, so recursor construction goes through; only strict positivity rejects it.
cases.name: non-strictly-positive

cases.description: `axiom foo : Sort u` with no universe parameters declared: `u` is unbound.
cases.name: undefined-universe-parameter

cases.description: A constructor whose field mentions a constant named `_nested.X`: the prefix is reserved for the kernel's own nested-inductive auxiliaries.
cases.name: reserved-nested-prefix

cases.description: `unsafe def f : Prop := g` and `unsafe def g : Prop := f` as one mutual block.
cases.name: mutual-unsafe-pair

cases.description: A mutual block mixing an `unsafe` and a `partial` definition.
cases.name: mutual-mixed-safety

cases.description: A mutual unsafe block whose two definitions declare different universe parameters.
cases.name: mutual-mismatched-universes
cases.targets: check.rs: add_mutual (one universe list per block)
